title: Publish portable local 3D MCP, elephant workflow and standalone LTC proof
objective: Publish all local 3D source, documented modeling/critique/lighting methods and reviewable examples to the owner's KHOSAN-TIME-STUDIO GitHub repository, with installation and real fresh-location validation for another computer.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve reviewed r6 source/artifacts and history while preparing a separate portable release candidate.
Base MCP installation and proof run from a fresh directory with spaces/non-Latin characters and explicit Blender discovery; do not require the owner's C drive layout.
Generate machine-specific MCP configuration locally and keep dependencies, caches, local paths and credentials out of the Git publication set.
Provide a locked optional standalone V4/LTC proof runtime; existing V4 mode remains explicitly scoped and must not be silently required on a fresh computer.
Include reproducible recipes, exact owner reference, actual small preview/evidence examples, critic/repair history and truthful limitations; do not label historical images as new-source renders.
Validate official MCP, Blender build/export/reimport and optional standalone renderer on actual environments; report untested OS/hardware accurately.
Independent reviewer returns ACCEPT for the portable source and installation workflow before publishing.
Publish a non-destructive GitHub commit based on the current main head with a lease; read back changed file identities and commit after the update.
verification: Actual fresh-location Windows install, SDK proof and four-view export
Actual standalone V4 runtime install and LTC-control rendering without private channel sources
Cross-platform script validation and Linux proof where available
Curated publication inventory, source/artifact hashes and GitHub readback
human_gates: User explicitly authorized publishing all approaches to GitHub and preparing use on another computer in this turn.
No additional confirmation is required for the bounded non-destructive GitHub publication.
Do not include credentials, paid side effects, automatic production rendering or schedule changes.
dependencies: Existing installed Blender for validation; documented install prerequisite
Node and optional pinned Remotion/Three runtime
risks: Machine-specific Blender and Chrome paths may be lost across stdio child environments.
Copied old review status must remain historical and cannot approve changed implementation hashes.
Standalone proof must distinguish its runtime checks from original private V4 source verification.
Rendering appearance can vary across GPUs and Blender versions.
notes: This is shared Studio tooling, not episode production. Current user approval accepts the progress and authorizes GitHub publication; preserve specific r6 appearance limitations. Work in an isolated release copy, validate before pushing, and keep the accepted owner-PC runtime recoverable. Published source release 73f468e3ea0b883bf47271b8f48b2efd93f81069 with independent ACCEPT and a non-force expected-head lease. All91 changed blob IDs/modes were read back;147 unrelated base blobs remain unchanged. Publication receipt: docs/examples/local3d/publication-receipt.json.
